meta.coverage: Res 368-578 (Jul 2023-Jun 2026); Res 1-367 pending capture. Titles are condensed summaries.
meta.listing_schema: number · short_title · date · tags - open RES-XXX.json for the full record.
collection_findings: Roughly half the adopted resolutions are ceremonial (congratulations to licensure topnotchers, athletes, scholars) - the Parliament functions as the region's official recognizer of achievement.
A steady stream condemns killings of professionals (doctors, lawyers, election officers, educators) and demands investigations - a running index of the region's security incidents against civilians.
Oversight resolutions repeatedly ask ministries (esp. MBHTE, MOH, MSSD, BPDA) for status reports - the Parliament's main accountability tool short of legislation.

Inter-governmental resolutions lobby Manila: transition extension to 2028 (Res 505), Kutawato Province creation (499), Shari'ah High Court organization (458), DPWH-BARMM office (547), Sulu-exclusion motions (507).
Distinctive foreign-policy voice: Gaza ceasefire resolutions (407, 419) - rare for a subnational legislature.
Political-support resolutions cluster around leadership transitions (courtesy resignations 552, Macacua support 578/576) - markers of the 2025 power shift.
